title: Write a detailed prompt that specifies audio/background music, character identity and clothing, camera movement (e.g....
content: Write a detailed prompt that specifies audio/background music, character identity and clothing, camera movement (e.g., camera pulls back), setting style (e.g., modern suburban photorealistic home), and a clear sequence of actions/transitions (e.g., character yanked out of the screen into the real world) to guide Seedance 2.0 toward the intended result.
description:
You can just do things with Seedance 2.0

A bit of imagination into a really good explanation of what you want to achieve, and stuff gets done.

SD2 doesn't fail. It's impeccable!

Thanks @capcutap...
tips: The iconic opening riff of the GTA: San Andreas theme plays in the background. We see Carl "CJ" Johnson from the back (wearing his iconic white tank top, blue jeans, and a gold chain) walking down an alley; the camera pulls back to reveal a modern, suburban, photorealistic home where a kid is playing the game on the couch. Carl (the videogame character) is suddenly being yanked backwards directly out of the screen, stumbling onto the floor of the quiet suburban house. Now jarringly photorealistic, wearing his white tank top, baggy jeans, he says: "Here we go again..." The player is stunned, looks at him, and says quietly: "Wow..."

Vemos a Carl "CJ" Johnson de espaldas (vistiendo su icónica camiseta sin mangas blanca, jeans azules y una cadena de oro) caminando por un callejón; la cámara se aleja para revelar una casa moderna, suburbana y fotorrealista donde un niño está jugando en el sofá. Carl (el personaje del videojuego) es repentinamente arrancado hacia atrás directamente de la pantalla, tropezando en el suelo de la tranquila casa suburbana. Ahora sorprendentemente fotorrealista, vistiendo su camiseta sin mangas blanca, jeans holgados, dice: "Aquí vamos de nuevo..." El jugador, atónito, lo mira y dice en voz baja: "Wow..."

Carl (le personnage du jeu vidéo) est soudainement tiré en arrière directement hors de l'écran, trébuchant sur le sol de la maison tranquille de banlieue. Maintenant étonnamment photoréaliste, portant son débardeur blanc, son jean ample, il dit : "C'est reparti..." Le joueur est stupéfait, le regarde et dit doucement : "Wow..."

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] GTA: San Andreas 테마의 상징적인 오프닝 리프가 배경에서 재생됩니다. 우리는 Carl "CJ" Johnson이 그의 상징적인 흰색 탱크탑, 청바지, 금목걸이를 입고 골목을 걸어가는 뒷모습을 봅니다. 카메라가 뒤로 당겨지면서 현대적이고 교외의 포토리얼리스틱한 집이 드러나고, 그곳에서 한 아이가 소파에 앉아 게임을 하고 있습니다. Carl(비디오 게임 캐릭터)은 갑자기 화면 밖으로 직접 끌려 나와 조용한 교외 집의 바닥에 비틀거리며 넘어집니다. 이제 충격적으로 포토리얼리스틱한 모습으로, 흰색 탱크탑과 헐렁한 청바지를 입고 그는 말합니다: "Here we go again..." 플레이어는 놀라서 그를 바라보며 조용히 말합니다: "Wow..."
